verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Stripe supports webhook endpoints for asynchronous event delivery (stripe-docs-8, stripe-docs-35, stripe-docs-53) and idempotent request handling (stripe-docs-9, stripe-docs-25, stripe-docs-42), which supports consistency guarantees, but the pack contains no documentation of signature verification (Stripe-Signature header), automatic retry behavior for failed webhook deliveries, an event log dashboard, or an event replay feature. missing for 10: explicit webhook signing/verification docs, automatic retry policy details, event log/dashboard evidence, and replay capability documentation.
